data.name: MinimaxHailuo03FirstLastFrameNode
data.description: Generate video from a first frame image and an optional last frame image using the MiniMax H3 models. The aspect ratio of the video follows the supplied images.

input_details.name: model
input_details.tooltip: Model to use for video generation.
input_details.hint: Dynamic combo: pick one `options` value for `model`, then send each conditional sub-field below using its full dotted name (prefixed with `model.`, e.g. `model.<sub_field>`). Auto-grow list slots nest one level deeper (e.g. `model.<list>.<slot_1>`). Sending these fields flat (without the prefix) fails with required_input_missing.

input_details.name: model.duration
input_details.tooltip: Duration of the output video in seconds (4-15).

input_details.name: model.prompt_expansion_mode
input_details.tooltip: How much effort is spent rewriting the prompt before generation.

input_details.name: first_frame
input_details.tooltip: First frame image for the video.

input_details.name: seed
input_details.tooltip: Random seed. The same request with the same seed gives similar, but not guaranteed identical, results.

input_details.name: watermark
input_details.tooltip: Whether to add an AIGC watermark to the video.

input_details.name: last_frame
input_details.tooltip: Optional last frame image for the video.
